p: We develop reliable Web design and development and scalable software solutions for any OS, browser and device. We bring together deep industry expertise and the latest IT advancements to deliver custom solutions and products that perfectly fit the needs and behavior of their users.
We provide Custom Software Development Services and Dedicated IT-Consultancy With Vast Industry-Specific Experience

sections.heading: ERP Design and Development
sections.text: Operating on the software development market for over 6 years, BBTECH has built its expertise in ERP consulting , development services by designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise resource planning software and its components.

items.title: ERP Consultancy
items.text: We help businesses select a suitable technological foundation for their ERP solutions. By making an informed choice, we ensure the healthy performance, painless scaling, and effortless management of ERP systems.

items.title: Design and implementation
items.text: We are experienced in architecting platform-based and custom ERP systems from scratch. We also deliver integrated ERP modules and custom features for on-premises, cloud and hybrid deployments.

items.title: ERP Customization
items.text: Whether you run a platform-based ERP solution or a completely custom system, BBTECH’s team will deliver customizations optimal for your specific business context. We put extra efforts into testing every customization so that it functions smoothly within the integrated environment.

items.title: ERP Integration
items.text: We provide integration of your company ERP with third-party apps and technologies. for example, shopify, Magento, Prestashop, WordPress, Whatsapp, Microsoft 365, POS etc
